Leo Lyons showed a return to form after prolonged injury while 15 year old Gary McGurren ran an exceptional 16.16 in his first attempt at this event.

Much of this success should be credited to Mat Kinane, finishing as the individual overall winner of the Herne Hill League, consistently shadowed all season by Gary McGurren, taking 3rd place overall against such strong opposition - these were remarkable performances.

Martin Lake ran slightly outside his best for this course to finish second in the handicap but young Gary McGurren confirmed that he will be one to watch in the future with an excellent run and a fine win in the handicap.
